source.title: 5x5x5 Blindfolded result missing on the score sheet
source.content: A competitor got a succesful 5x5x5 Blindfolded solve. The result wasn't written on the score sheet, but the competitor had recorded the solve, so the time was retrieved from the video and the result accepted as official.

translation.title: 五阶盲拧成绩未写入成绩单
translation.content: 一名选手成功完成五阶盲拧，但成绩未写入成绩单。选手录下了该次还原，因此从视频中恢复了用时，并将成绩接受为正式成绩。
